propositions: ADR 0098 must document the approved decision that Rebar composes immutable non-secret operation configuration separately from provider-auth and runtime bindings at application boundaries.
The ADR must cite completed primary-source research on Pydantic, OpenAI, Anthropic, boto3/AWS, Git credential helpers, and Rebar's current probes for all external dependency behavior claims.

ADR 0098 must narrow ADR 0049 only at the per-job retrieval/composition seam while explicitly preserving all unaffected decisions and recording relationships to ADRs 0008, 0014, 0041, 0046, 0050, 0059, and 0083.

The documentation must pass ADR-number, index, and docs checks; contain no placeholders or merge-conflict markers; and include a numbered Draft Critique identifying unresolved uncited claims, inconsistencies, missing constraints, and ADR conflicts.
This task is documentation-only and must not start RP-04 implementation; maintainer approval is required before HOLD/MERGE and implementation decomposition.
